title: USCG Navigation Restriction Resolver input
description: Provide exactly one of point, route or bbox (coordinates in WGS84 decimal degrees). Returns official USCG NAVCEN maritime safety information records that intersect the area. Not navigational advice.

point.title: Point
point.description: A position {"lat": 27.9506, "lon": -80.4547}. Notices within radiusNm are returned.

radiusNm.title: Radius (nautical miles)
radiusNm.description: Search radius around point. Default 5, range 0.1-50.

route.title: Route
route.description: User-supplied route as 2-200 ordered positions [{"lat":..,"lon":..}, ...], up to 1500 nm. The Actor does not plan routes.

corridorNm.title: Corridor half-width (nautical miles)
corridorNm.description: Distance either side of the route. Default 1, range 0.1-25.

bbox.title: Bounding box
bbox.description: {"south":..,"west":..,"north":..,"east":..}, at most 10 degrees per side; must not cross the antimeridian.

atTime.title: At time (UTC)
atTime.description: ISO 8601 time with timezone used to classify notices as active, upcoming or expired. Default: now.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Limit to these categories. Default: all of safety_zone, hazard_to_navigation, marine_construction, marine_event, naval_activity, space_operation, temporary_change, tess_advisory, msib.
